hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition; compute capability 12.0; CUDA 12.9.86; driver 595.99.02
diagnosis: Energy finite differences are smooth over 1e-2 to 1e-6 Bohr, so the discrepancy is not a noisy or under-resolved finite-difference reference.
CPU GenerativeQC uses the same energy and passes the derivative check, so public unit conversion, atom order and the mathematical PBE energy are not the cause.
RHF and B3LYP CUDA force paths pass while LDA/PBE/PBE0/r2SCAN fail; the defect is in a method-specific CUDA DFT stationary-force owner/profile, not generic CUDA loading.
Changing initial_guess and Cartesian/spherical representation does not repair PBE, so the defect is not an SCF warm-start or AO representation choice.
The PBE CUDA capability advertises forces despite this failed numerical gate; capability admission is therefore insufficient evidence of force qualification for this build.
The returned CUDA vector is not exactly the nuclear-repulsion force; it is best classified as an incomplete or incorrect stationary-force assembly until upstream source-level ownership is corrected.
claim_limits: This diagnoses the current GenerativeQC commit/build on this GPU and method matrix; it does not prove every future commit or GPU fails.
No chemistry accuracy, TS, IRC or CP2K-equivalence claim is made.
CUDA PBE/LDA/PBE0/r2SCAN forces remain quarantined from xtbflow reference labels.

source_inspection.semilocal_force_admission: The semilocal_force condition admits CUDA when ks_options exists, coefficients equal (1,1,0), and the graph is not nonlocal; this broad path is later OR-ed into supported_properties forces for native DFT method IDs.
source_inspection.native_cuda_model_probe_scope: native_cuda_stationary_model_available is explicitly called in the automatic Libxc branch, but named pbe-rks/lda-rks/r2scan-rks paths can reach the broad CUDA semilocal_force branch without an equivalent exact numerical force gate.
source_inspection.observed_capability: Calculator.capabilities.supported_properties included forces for pbe-rks despite finite-difference failure.
source_inspection.likely_fix_boundary: Make named CUDA force admission depend on exact prepared-item/profile capability plus a retained finite-difference/independent-force qualification; otherwise expose energy only or fail closed.
